fixes.what: Attach a transitionend listener to the accordion container (on 'height' or 'flex') or call ScrollTrigger.refresh() inside togglePhone() when a panel toggles on mobile.
fixes.why: Toggling accordion panels on mobile alters the document height, causing downstream ScrollTrigger start/end positions (journey line, ground trunk fade) to drift.

fixes.what: Remove loading="lazy" from the trunkLeft and trunkRight elements inside .tree-frame.
fixes.why: The trunks are fixed to the viewport and visible immediately on screen 1; lazy-loading above-the-fold fixed assets delays their initial paint.

fixes.what: Remove will-change: transform, opacity from .hero__foot (GSAP sets inline transforms during scrub anyway).
fixes.why: Keeping a permanent will-change layer on the huge SVG wordmark wastes GPU memory and can cause subtle rasterization blurring on some mobile browsers.

fixes.what: Add onRefresh: function(st) { if (st.progress > 0) { ... } } or ensure ScrollTrigger.refresh() is called if the user resizes across the 769px breakpoint.
fixes.why: When resizing across 769px, the journey track switches between horizontal and vertical SVG paths; forcing a ScrollTrigger refresh on desktopQuery change guarantees dash lengths recalculate immediately.
